name: Thyme
description: A low-growing woody perennial herb with tiny, highly aromatic gray-green leaves and clusters of pale purple summer blossoms.
use: Soups and stews. Bees love its flowers. Adds earthy warmth to slow-cooked sauces and marinades.
tips: Very drought-tolerant once established. Prune lightly after blooming to prevent leggy growth and encourage fresh tender shoots.
